wholePhysicalScope: One outer footprint assembled from two mapped ways, nine building parts, four CC0 exterior images and original regional elevation.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the round west pavilion, gold tower, mural walls and angular east volumes. Near levels add glazing, stairs and tile variation.
limitations: The asset shows the museum’s 2015 canal-side exterior, including four architectural pavilions and the nearest bridge span. Interior and temporary exhibition displays are excluded.

Pavilion heights, grades and the eastern folded panels are approximated from documented footprints and photos. Patterns are represented with procedural color and material variation. No photographic art or logos are included.
